title: Surreal Mirror Fairy
description: A woman with large green insect wings stands at the center of a fantastical surreal scene, wearing a mirrored disco-ball bodice covered in flowers. She raises one hand toward a beam of light while surrounded by melting clocks, golden apples, floating eyeballs, jellyfish, an octopus, a sailboat on a river, and a swirling galaxy visible through a large mirror.
prompt: A beautiful woman with large translucent green fairy wings stands in the center of a highly detailed surreal dreamscape. She wears a reflective mirrorball bodice adorned with colorful flowers and has a flower crown. One arm is raised. The scene includes melting golden clocks and apples, floating eyeballs, glowing jellyfish, a green octopus, a sailboat on a river flowing through a mirror that shows a swirling galaxy, crumbling stone ruins, all rendered in rich vibrant colors with dramatic lighting.
